en.hubeali: From him, from Al Haysam, from Abdul Aziz Bin Umar, from one of his companions, from Yahya Bin Imran Al Halby who said,

‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘Which is the most beautiful characteristics of the man?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Dignity without a reverence, and open-handedness without seeking a recompense, and pre-occupation with other than the chattels of the world’.
en.sarwar: 33. It is narrated from him (narrator of the Hadith above) from al-Haytham al-Nahdi from ‘Abd al-‘Aziz ibn ‘Umar from certain individuals of his people from Yahya ibn ‘Imran al-Halabi who has said the following:

“Once I asked abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) ‘Which quality is more graceful for a man?’ The Imam said, ‘Of such qualities are: reverence that is not a cause for any fear, magnanimity without expecting any recompense, and business, but not in worldly matters.’”
